rationale: Every supplied artifact use of claim C-CHAL-004 consistently preserves its scope and limitations. The artifacts explicitly state that EASA NPA 2025-07(B) is 'proposed, not final material' and highlight its exclusion of AI-based systems directly contributing to fatalities or multiple life-threatening injuries, aligning with the claim's wording and the supporting evidence from NPA 2025-07(B) DS.AI.010 Scope. Visual and narrative guidance in the video-related artifacts also reinforces these qualifications, preventing overstatement or misrepresentation of the proposed material's status or applicability to the project's most demanding flight-critical autonomy case.
